test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative. **

I am looking forward to _________ you at our favourite restaurant.
solution:
The correct answer is: **meeting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present continuous tense, indicating a future event.
 
• The verb "**look forward to**" is followed by a **gerund **(verb + ing).
 
• "**Meeting**" is the correct gerund form of the verb "meet."
 
• In the context of the statement, the gerund "**meeting**" takes on the role of the object of the preposition "**to**."
 
• It indicates the action that the speaker is looking forward to.
 
• Gerunds are commonly used in this way to express actions that serve as the focus or purpose of an action or event.
 
• The sentence means the speaker is excited to see the listener at their favourite restaurant in the future.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence:** *I am looking forward to meeting __you at our favourite restaurant.*
